description: This file is a configuration for testing setup using pytest fixtures in a Python project related to HTTP and URL transfer utilities. It sets up environment checks, logging, and fixtures for starting and stopping HTTP servers and proxies.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Represents the testing environment configuration and utilities to check server capabilities and setup status.

classes.name: Httpd
classes.description: Represents an HTTP daemon/server used in test setups, providing methods to check existence, start, stop, and clear logs.

classes.name: Nghttpx
classes.description: Represents an NGINX http proxy (nghttpx) used in tests, with methods to start, stop, and log management.

classes.name: NghttpxFwd
classes.description: Represents a forward proxy variant of Nghttpx for testing.

methods.name: Env env(pytestconfig)
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment, checks protocols support, and initializes clients.

methods.name: log_global_env_facts(record_testsuite_property, env)
methods.description: Records environment-related properties to the test suite report.

methods.name: Httpd httpd(env)
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server for testing, verifies existence, starts and stops the server.

methods.name: Optional[Nghttpx] nghttpx(env, httpd)
methods.description: Configures and manages an nghttpx proxy instance for testing.

methods.name: Optional[Nghttpx] nghttpx_fwd(env, httpd)
methods.description: Configures and manages a forward nghttpx proxy for testing.
